description: Run a standing team of agents that message each other, hand off work and wait for you only when they need an answer. You describe the team once in a crew.yaml: each member gets a fixed address, its own provider and model, a role and its own worktree, and every member is a thread in the sidebar. Several crews in one project coordinate through their leads, BB Tasks and the base branch, with a step limit so they cannot loop forever. A project overview shows who works, who waits and every cross-crew message. Merge and rebase need the repository on the machine BB runs on.
